components_strategy.hero_section: Massive H1 title, neon glowing primary CTA, dynamic abstract network background behind a dark overlay, floating stats or trust badges (e.g., 'Trusted by 10k+ Servers').
components_strategy.features_bento: Asymmetrical grid. Highlight Captcha Verification, Role Management, and Admin Controls. Use Lucide icons (Shield, Lock, Key, Settings) heavily.
components_strategy.how_it_works: Step-by-step visual flow. Simulated Discord UI mockup for the captcha modal.
components_strategy.premium_tier: Distinct styling (maybe a subtle gold/cyan mix) showcasing the /customization feature for embeds. Highlight 'Monetized via Discord'.
components_strategy.footer: Massive bottom space. Clean links to Docs, Support, Discord.

hero_bg.description: Abstract blue light streaks in dark, used for hero section background with heavy dark overlay
hero_bg.usage: Hero section background (`bg-cover`, `bg-center`, under a `bg-black/80` overlay)

premium_feature_bg.description: Geometric dark cubes representing structured data and premium customization.
premium_feature_bg.usage: Background for the Premium Customization feature block.

accessibility_and_motion.motion: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered entrance animations (fade up). Buttons must have explicit focus states (e.g., `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00E5FF]`).
